name: @openagt/notifications-command
description: A command of yours, run on this computer when a run needs you: when it ends waiting on a question, and when it opens a pull request. It gets one line for you, to post where you like, and is typed in one Settings entry, Notification command.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/test-node.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run
